news.title: Falcon 9 Booster Landing Team receives first Neil Armstrong Space Prize for reusable rocket research
news.summary_en: Purdue University’s Neil Armstrong Space Prize was awarded to the SpaceX Falcon 9 Booster Landing Team, recognizing their globally impactful work on the Falcon 9 reusable two-stage rocket system.

news.title: How SpaceX's Falcon 9 cracked rocket reusability: Purdue's 2026 Neil Armstrong Space Prize
news.summary_en: The Falcon 9 Booster Landing Team at SpaceX has been awarded the 2026 Neil Armstrong Space Prize in the Innovation category for proving that rockets could be recovered, refurbished and reused — a feat much of the industry once considered impossible.

news.title: Lyles School taps UC San Diego's Michael Todd as its next head
news.summary_en: Purdue Engineering has selected Michael D. Todd as the next Bowen Engineering Head of the Lyles School of Civil and Construction Engineering.

news.title: Award-winning Purdue Engineering research targets a persistent solid-state battery problem
news.summary_en: Aditya Singla used computer modeling to uncover how defects form at battery interfaces, with implications for safer, higher-energy density lithium and sodium batteries.
